item.title: Designing a data platform on a homelab k3s cluster
item.description:
A lakehouse in my basement Link to heading

I run a few websites from a small Kubernetes cluster at home. All public traffic goes through one reverse proxy, and its access log was already being sent to Kafka. Then nothing happened to it. I wanted to answer simple questions: how many people visit each site, which pages they read, how fast the pages are, and who is scanning for /wp-admin this week.
